problem_summary: 5 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Sarvagna Nagar between February 2019 and April 2022, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 80% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

agency_attribution_note: 5 of 5 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.48). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.80, description_severity=0.18.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Sarvagna Nagar' not found in name crosswalk (one of the 15 unmatched wards). No enrichment applied.
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Sarvagna Nagar for the period 2019–2022.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
